//: `include` reaches across the workspace on purpose. @rollup/plugin-typescript
only transforms files its tsconfig selects, and this bundle pulls TypeScript
straight out of ui-kit/, frontend/core/ and modules/*/ui — the workspace
packages resolve to source, not to a build, which is what lets `#profile`
pick the compact implementation at bundle time (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §2.3).
Without these entries Rollup gets `export type *` as raw text and stops.
